name: Enterprise Research Study and Experiment
constraints: WM-ACT-036 owns Research Study and immutable study-scoped design releases; WM-KNW-009 owns Hypothesis.
WM-ACT-022 is completed narrowly as Experiment Run with subordinate attempts, manifests, deviations, access events and coverage.
Research Finding mints no new model identity but requires a composed instance identity resolved through WM-KNW-007.
Finding assertions record uncertainty, applicability, limitations, cited runs and source-qualified assessment and supersede only by successor assertion.
Post-hoc hypotheses are new WM-KNW-009 instances; pre-access refinement alone may create a revision.
Observation, dataset, analysis and finding remain separate; findings cite and never own their sources.
Supported, unsupported, refuted, null, no-effect and inconclusive remain source-qualified and distinct.
Evidence Artifact is a pinned unassigned dependency on EM-KNW-02 and creates no local duplicate.
holds: No new model or runtime identity is minted.
Evidence Artifact and reusable design remain unassigned dependencies.
